author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Before AI, I never pay attention to any poster or movie style, how they use color, layout the design. I just passively consume them.

Now with AI, I know those things are within my reach. I start paying alot more attention to all the visual I encounter day to day. I want to understand why it is draw this way, what effect it brings to the viewer.

AI open a whole new window for me to experience the world.
